name: Rublon MFA
summary: Rublon MFA charges $2 per user per month on its Business plan with a 15-license minimum, and $4 on Enterprise with a 300-license minimum. The Free plan protects one user and leaves out the network, device and location policies.

evidence.capability: second-factor methods such as app push or hardware keys

facts.text: Every plan lists Mobile Push, FIDO, QR Code, Email Link, Passcode and SMS Passcode methods.
Authorized Networks, Remembered Devices and Geolocation policies are included in Business and Enterprise but not in Free.
All three plans let admins choose Automatic, Manual or Approval enrollment, and users can also self-enroll.
Phone credits for SMS Passcode, SMS Link and Phone Call cost extra on every plan.
Rublon reports an ISO/IEC 27001:2023 certified management system and states that its practices adhere to the EU GDPR.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Protects 1 user. Community support only. The trial converts to Free when it expires

hiddenCosts: SMS and phone call credits are charged on top of the license price on all plans.
Phone support is an optional extra on Business and Enterprise.
